statement: Inside and outside together: signs carrying both outer and inner marks (all 4 such pairs in the blind annotation: fish G226, G232, G234 vs G220, and diamond G852 vs G850) sit in the end region more often than their plain bases. Classes as fixed in results/mark_classes.md; closers as in H-2026-10-21-be9ab5ab. Exploration +0.35 (p 0.0005), carried by the three fish. Position test, complete texts only. Data: the held-out-from-export set (data/icit_merged_paragorth/new_to_export_corpus.csv; ICIT objects absent from this project's export, never used in any analysis here; not independent of ICIT). Registered before the set was analysed (protocol: predictions/newset_protocol_2026-10-23.md). One run. BH within the new-set batch.
author: Erin (RN-Top); prepared by Claude
